scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@whoosh/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@whoosh/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@whoosh/shared && npm run build --workspace=@whoosh/api && npm run build --workspace=@whoosh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@whoosh/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@whoosh/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@whoosh/web
